title: EVM Charge Intent for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-evm-charge-00)
quote: the control flow, data structures, and verification logic are identical across these chains [so EVM chains are unified under a single 'evm' method]. ... The signature cannot be reused against a different challenge, even if the payment parameters are identical. ... [splits] all succeed or all revert. Authors: Brett DiNovi (MegaETH Labs), Conner Swenberg (Coinbase), Kyle Scott (Monad Foundation); dated 3 June 2026, expires 5 December 2026.

title: Machine Payments Protocol (MPP) Specifications — index
quote: Core: The 'Payment' HTTP Authentication Scheme (draft-httpauth-payment-00), Payment Discovery, JSON-RPC & MCP Transport; Charge/Intent methods: Card, EVM, Hedera, Lightning, Solana, Stellar, Stripe, Tempo; Session: Lightning Session, Tempo Session. Maintained via GitHub (tempoxyz/mpp-specs).

title: The "Payment" HTTP Authentication Scheme (draft-ryan-httpauth-payment-01)
quote: The protocol is payment-method agnostic, supporting any payment network or currency through registered payment method identifiers. [WWW-Authenticate: Payment carries id, realm, method, intent, request, optional expires; Authorization: Payment carries base64url JSON {challenge, source, payload}. Active Internet-Draft, not IETF-endorsed; March 2026.]

title: Service Discovery for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-payment-discovery-00)
quote: Services publish an OpenAPI document annotated with payment extensions that describe pricing, payment methods, and intent types, serving as the canonical machine-readable contract. If a server supports multiple intents, it may issue multiple challenges with different intent types like 'charge' or 'authorize'.

title: What Is MPP? The Machine Payments Protocol by Tempo Explained
quote: MPP is backward-compatible with x402 at the charge layer. ... MPP eliminates the facilitator concept and ships production-ready fiat support, while x402 prioritizes permissionlessness. ... Tempo operates as a VC-backed L1 with centralized validator sets at launch.

title: What is MPP? Dual Payment Protocol
quote: MPP activates HTTP's dormant 402 status code with a challenge-response payment flow, separating the core authentication scheme from per-method specifications (Tempo, Stripe, Solana, Card) and intents (charge, session).
